items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 1:1
items.html: Light is everything that is received in the worlds in the manner of “existence from existence,” which includes everything except the substance of the vessels. See Item 2 and Item 24. (Part 1, Inner Observation, Item 18)
